description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Dataset_Sequential', a dataset class for sequential data points in a graph, extending 'Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial'. It includes methods for adding points, retrieving X values, and determining min/max X values.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Sequential
classes.description: A dataset class for sequential (1D) data points where X-values are implicitly incremented, useful for bar charts and similar visualizations.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Sequential
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset, optionally with an array of data points.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new point to the dataset with an implicit X-value based on the current count.

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Returns the X value for a given point, cast to an integer.

methods.name: minimumX
methods.description: Returns the minimum X value, which is 0.

methods.name: maximumX
methods.description: Returns the maximum X value, which is the current count of points.
